title: ASIS operative lent to MI6 to bug Kuwaiti government

tellings.quote: And so, the Brits secretly borrowed one of the technical operators buggers from Australia to win a commercial advantage against Australia by bugging the Kuwaiti government offices on behalf of British intelligence.

plain: In the early 1990s, British intelligence, MI6, secretly borrowed one of the technical 'buggers' of ASIS, Australia's foreign spy service, and used him to bug the Kuwaiti government's offices, to win business advantage over Australia itself. The investigative journalist Ross Coulthart tells Michels this as a story from his reporting on intelligence. It is told as an example of how allied spy services can quietly work against each other.
